mitigations.description: 7-day MetaMorpho timelock delay before submitCap execution

rules.note: 7-day MetaMorpho timelock on the (curator→submitCap) edge. MetaMorpho 7-day timelock — anchored on the (owner→submitCap) permission edge so it appears in the curator/owner admin view but does NOT propagate as a spurious 7d delay onto Morpho/Chainlink dependencies. Replaces the function-level mitigation on submitCap, which was treated as global by getMitigationsForOwner and incorrectly tagged downstream view-reads. See docs/developers/designs/edge-centric-constraints.md.
